Introduction

i
WelcomePage 3 of 3

Having trouble signing in to the GM Early Years App? You are not alone, and it is not your fault.

If you have tried before and it did not work, it usually comes down to one small detail. This guide will help you find it, one step at a time.

Tip: read the guide on a second screen

  • A family member’s phone
  • A computer
  • A printed copy

Then follow the steps on your own iPhone.

Tap Next when you are ready.

BackContents3 / 85Next

How this guide works

Section 1 · How this guide worksPage 1 of 1

You do not need to work out what is wrong. This guide does that with you.

Here is what will happen:

  1. 1Check what you need: your Health Visiting team, your account, and 4 quick Yes or No questions
  2. 2Sign in, one step at a time, with a picture of each screen
  3. 3Get the right help if something is not right: who to contact and what to do

Stage 1 of 3 · What you need

About your account

Section 3 · About your accountPage 1 of 2

Who will be set up with an account?

Your Health Visiting team sets up a GM Early Years App account for the child's mother or primary carer. In this guide, we call this person the account holder.

Who will be able to access the account?

Only the account holder. They sign in with the same email address and password as their own NHS login.

Who will not be able to access the account?

A partner or another family member cannot sign in to the account.

BackContents6 / 85Next

Your account details

Section 3 · About your accountPage 2 of 2

Your details must be exactly the same in NHS login and the GM Early Years App.

  • Same details: you can sign in.
  • Different details: ask your HV team.

For example:

NHS login
Given nameCharlotte
SurnameSomers
NHS number485 777 3456
Mobile07700 900123
Emailc.somers@example.com
=
GM Early Years App
Given nameCharlotte
SurnameSomers
NHS number485 777 3456
Mobile07700 900123
Emailc.somers@example.com

Part 1 of 3 · Get started

Step 1 of 15: Restart your iPhone

Section 5 · Signing inPage 2 of 18

Restarting first helps the sign-in go smoothly.

  • Turn off your iPhone.
  • Wait at least 15 seconds.
  • Turn your iPhone back on.
How to turn your iPhone off and on

Off: on most iPhones, hold the side button and a volume button until the slider appears, then drag it. On: hold the side button until the Apple logo appears.

How to install the App

Section 6 · TroubleshootingPage 26 of 41

Details do not match

Section 6 · TroubleshootingPage 38 of 41

Your team can put this right.

i

The issue

Your App account was set up with an email address or mobile number that does not match your NHS login.

Who can help

Your Health Visiting team

What to do

Ask the team to update your App account so it matches your NHS login details.

Find your Health Visiting team
Still stuck?Get help

Partner's details used

Section 6 · TroubleshootingPage 39 of 41

Your team can put this right.

i

The issue

Your App account was set up with your partner's email address or mobile number, not your own.

Who can help

Your Health Visiting team

What to do

Ask the team to change your App account to your own email address and mobile number.

Find your Health Visiting team
Still stuck?Get help
BackContents70 / 85Done

A partner is signing in

Section 6 · TroubleshootingPage 40 of 41

Here is what to do instead.

i

The issue

The App account is for the child's mother or primary carer. A partner cannot sign in to it.

Who can help

Your Health Visiting team

What to do

The person named on the account must sign in with their own NHS login. If the account is for the wrong person, ask the team.

Find your Health Visiting team
Still stuck?Get help

Accessibility statement

Section 8 · About this guidePage 3 of 8

This statement is for the GM Early Years App iPhone guide, run by the Greater Manchester Combined Authority (GMCA).

We want as many people as possible to be able to use it. You should be able to:

  • zoom in up to 200% without text being cut off
  • use portrait or landscape, and Dark Mode
  • search by typing, or by voice in Safari
  • move between pages with Back and Next, or by swiping
BackContents80 / 85Next

Known issues

Section 8 · About this guidePage 4 of 8

Compliance status

We believe this guide meets WCAG 2.2 AA, but it has not had a full independent audit yet. Until then, it is partially compliant.

What may not work well

  • Text does not grow with the iPhone’s Larger Text setting. Zoom with Safari’s aA button instead.
  • Screenshots show text from the App and NHS login. Each has a written description, and the steps are written out.
  • The guide has not yet been tested with people who use screen readers.
BackContents81 / 85Next

Feedback and contact

Section 8 · About this guidePage 5 of 8

If you need this guide in a different format, such as large print, easy read or another language, or you find a problem not listed here, email the GMDP Support Team:

gmdp.support@greatermanchester-ca.gov.uk

We will consider your request and get back to you.

If you are not happy with our reply

The Equality and Human Rights Commission (EHRC) enforces the accessibility regulations. If you are not happy with how we respond, contact the Equality Advisory and Support Service (EASS).

BackContents82 / 85Next

How it was tested

Section 8 · About this guidePage 6 of 8

GMCA is committed to making this guide accessible, in line with the Public Sector Bodies (Websites and Mobile Applications) (No. 2) Accessibility Regulations 2018.

On 20 November 2026 the guide was checked:

  • with an automated tool (axe-core) on every page, in light and Dark Mode
  • on 13 iPhone screen sizes, and at 200% zoom
  • in portrait and landscape

This statement was prepared on 20 November 2026. It will be reviewed by November 2027.

BackContents83 / 85Next

Your privacy

Section 8 · About this guidePage 7 of 8

This guide does not collect any information about you.

  • No sign-in, no cookies and no tracking.
  • What you type and choose stays on your iPhone. It is cleared when you close the guide.
  • Voice search uses Apple’s speech service, only if you tap the microphone.
  • The website host, GitHub, may keep technical details such as IP addresses.

Questions? Email GMDP Support.
